newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 19.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 58.92 points to 6,896.56, after falling 100 points earlier in the session, as a strong housing report reignited fears the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates in a bid to ward off inflation.
* Telkom ADS in New York fell to $30-1/8 on Tuesday from $30-1/4 on Monday. In London Telkom rose to $30.35 on Tuesday from $29.1750 on Monday. One ADS represents 20 ordinary shares.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index closed 11.50 points lower at 659.44 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,406.25/06.75 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,405.30/05.80
* Telkom following sharp falls in Jakarta on Tuesday due to earlier reports of a possible competitor linked to politically well-connected businessmen.
* Fishery firm Daya Guna Samudra on reports that President Suharto's son Bambang Trihatmodjo was likely to acquire large stake in the firm.
* Prasidha as the commodity trading firm expected to record net profits of 40 billion rupiah in 1997 against 30.7 billion rupiah in 1996.
* Transportation firm Mitra Rajasa on market talk business tycoon Yopie Widjaja plans to acquire the firm. Widjadja has denied the rumour.
